title: Three Arms and One Plate: The Delta Robot, Its Closed Form Both Ways, and Why It Is So Fast

artifact.note: the delta robot: three motors on a fixed base, each turning an upper arm whose end is joined by a parallelogram of two rods to a small platform that never tilts; the inverse kinematics in closed form (each arm on its own, in the plane through its motor axis, as the intersection of two circles), the forward kinematics as the meeting of three spheres, the joint limits, the shape of the reach found by sampling, and the moving mass compared with a six axis arm
